picks.editorial_note: NASA's formal entry into the Genesis Mission marks the initiative's transition from a DOE program into a true whole-of-government effort spanning 15+ federal agencies, launched by executive order — a signal of how central AI has become to U.S. science policy.
picks.title: NASA Joins Genesis Mission to Accelerate AI-Driven Discovery - NASA

picks.editorial_note: CuspAI's £330 million raise at a £2 billion valuation, with an Imperial College scientist as Chief Scientific Officer, dwarfs every individual Genesis Mission award this week and shows serious private capital betting on AI-driven materials discovery.
picks.title: Imperial expert leads science at £2 billion AI materials company CuspAI

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's role leading 13 Genesis Mission projects and partnering on 30+ more makes it one of the single largest institutional stakes in the national AI-for-science initiative.
picks.title: Berkeley Lab to Lead 13 New Genesis Mission AI Projects

picks.editorial_note: Oak Ridge National Laboratory leading nine Genesis Mission projects and contributing to 32 others cements its position as a linchpin of the DOE's AI, supercomputing, and quantum strategy.
picks.title: Department of Energy selects ORNL to lead nine Genesis Mission projects | ORNL

picks.editorial_note: The Apertus 1.5 release from EPFL, ETH Zurich, and CSCS adds multimodal capability to one of the few fully open large language models trained on a national supercomputer, a notable counterpoint to closed frontier models.
picks.title: Apertus 1.5: Building the next generation of open AI infrastructure

picks.editorial_note: A new deep learning model from CMU, Pitt, and UW researchers revealed how 3D genome architecture differs in Alzheimer's disease, a concrete biomedical discovery enabled by AI rather than just AI-adjacent funding.
picks.title: AI, Single-Cell Technology Reveal How 3D Genome Differs in People With Alzheimer's Disease

picks.editorial_note: Penn State's $20 million NSF award to lead a national 'programmable cloud laboratory' node represents a major bet on automating the scientific method itself with AI.
picks.title: Penn State awarded $20M to lead an NSF ‘programmable cloud laboratory’ | Penn State University

picks.editorial_note: TUM and MIT are deepening a formal exchange program sending researchers between MIRMI and CSAIL for AI and robotics work, backed by Bavarian state funding — a concrete transatlantic academic partnership rather than a one-off grant.
picks.title: TUM and MIT are expanding their strategic partnership in the fields of AI and robotics. The Bavarian Ministry of Science is providing 1.6 million.

picks.editorial_note: UW, Carnegie Mellon, and SLAC are building a shared AI-driven data service to unify cosmology datasets, a novel cross-institutional application of AI to accelerate discovery in astrophysics.
picks.title: UW researchers join national effort to streamline AI-driven cosmology

picks.editorial_note: RWTH Aachen and NEURA Robotics are opening a 3,000-square-meter facility dedicated to physical AI and humanoid robotics, a substantial real-world infrastructure investment in embodied AI research.
picks.title: A Milestone for Physical AI | RWTH Aachen University | EN
